pages.text: To build a Fission Reactor, you need: a $(item)Fission Reactor Controller$(), $(item)Fission Reactor Casing$()s, $(item)Fission Reactor Fuel Cell$(), $(item)Fission Reactor Interface$(), $(item)Fission Reactor Cooling Cell$()(optional, but you may want it) and some fission reactor wall blocks(with tag #dustandash:blocks/fission_reactor_wall, like Grey Stained Glass)

You need to use $(item)Fission Reactor Casing$()s to make a frame, which length and width must be odd and equal (Height can be different). Then, design and place $(item)Fission Reactor Cooling Cell$() and $(item)Fission Reactor Fuel Cell$() in it and fill the wall with fission reactor wall block. Finally, Place the $(item)Fission Reactor Controller$() on the top middle of the structure, and place the $(item)Fission Reactor Interface$() on the middle of one of the side walls.

The fuel units and the cooling units can be inserted with the $(item)Fission Reactor Interface$(). You should try to let the heat of the reactor as close to the Ideal Heat of the fuel. You can decrease the heat-increase by placing $(item)Fission Reactor Cooling Cell$() beside $(item)Fission Reactor Fuel Cell$().
